name: Route 6 Coffee & Smoothies
notes: Photo 1 shows an older laminated menu board with different prices/items than photos 2-4, which show a newer green-bordered menu (photographed indoors and outdoors) with updated prices. Used the newer, more corroborated version and dropped the superseded old-menu items/prices (e.g. old Turkey & Avocado $9, Balboa Club $11, Ham & Avocado, Spicy Chipotle, Veggie Sandwich, old Kids Menu) to avoid duplicating conflicting prices for the same dishes.
